title: Gen Z audio culture is being organized through fandom, life-stage rituals, cross-format participation, and identity practices that turn listening into belonging
source_unit: Spotify Advertising, Culture Next 2026: The Fan Edit
geography: Global Gen Z Spotify audience and audio, podcast, gaming, video, and fandom culture

observations.period: 2026; Gen Z streaming, rituals, and cultural participation

denominator.unit: Spotify Gen Z audience and Culture Next platform frame

audience_share.unit: percent of Spotify audience identified as Gen Z on the public Culture Next page

daily_streaming.unit: hours per day of streaming reported for Gen Z in the Culture Next public summary

culture_route.value: Streaming is framed as a site where Gen Z builds rituals and shapes culture in real time, with fandom forming through repeated media participation

observations.method: Spotify Culture Next platform summary combining Spotify audience and streaming signals with Gen Z cultural trend interpretation; the full report methodology is not publicly detailed on the landing page.
observations.uncertainty: Platform audience composition and streaming time are company-reported and do not represent all Gen Z people, all listening, or causal effects of Spotify use on identity or culture.
observations.subgroup: Gen Z listeners, podcast audiences, music fans, gamers, creators, advertisers, and people using audio to organize routines and belonging.
observations.counterinterpretation: Streaming may reflect existing identity and fandom rather than create it; heavy platform use can also indicate attention capture, commercial dependence, or unequal access to cultural participation.

observations.period: 2026; Power Up and identity through fitness and gaming

denominator.unit: Spotify Culture Next 2026 Power Up trend frame

power_up.value: Fitness and gaming are positioned as identity expressions for Gen Z rather than only activities or entertainment categories

ritualization.value: Audio is used to structure workouts, gaming sessions, social creation, and other recurring moments where identity is practiced and shared

cross_category_identity.value: Music, gaming, movement, and creator culture increasingly overlap in the same identity and fandom ecosystems

observations.method: Spotify Culture Next trend interpretation linking platform listening behavior to Gen Z fitness, gaming, creator, and identity practices.
observations.uncertainty: The public summary does not provide the prevalence of these overlaps, country differences, or evidence that audio participation changes fitness, gaming, or social outcomes.
observations.subgroup: Gen Z gamers, fitness participants, creators, fans, listeners, and communities organized around shared routines and media rituals.
observations.counterinterpretation: Cross-category identity may describe advertiser segmentation more than lived identity, and commercial platform design can turn community practices into monetizable attention packages.

observations.period: 2026; Eye Pods and cross-format audio-visual culture

denominator.unit: Spotify Culture Next 2026 Eye Pods trend frame

eye_pods.value: Gen Z is described as thinking across formats and wanting to hear and see, extending audio culture into video and visual participation

format_flexibility.value: Attention moves between music, podcasts, video, social clips, and creator formats rather than staying within one media container

creator_opportunity.value: The cross-format shift increases the importance of adaptable creators, visual context, and moments where fandom can move from listening into seeing and sharing

observations.method: Spotify Culture Next 2026 platform trend framing across audio, podcasts, video, creator content, and Gen Z media rituals.
observations.uncertainty: The public summary does not quantify time spent by format, substitution between audio and video, or whether cross-format use improves discovery, attention, or creator income.
observations.subgroup: Gen Z listeners and viewers, podcasters, musicians, video creators, fandom communities, and advertisers designing across audio-visual contexts.
observations.counterinterpretation: Cross-format consumption can increase creative reach but also fragment attention, intensify platform dependency, and expand unpaid demands on creators to produce everywhere.

denominator.unit: Spotify Culture Next 2026 fandom and emotional-media trend frame

dark_side.value: Grusel and other dark-but-playful content are framed as ways Gen Z processes real feelings through shared entertainment and controlled intensity

fandemonium.value: Fandom is presented as more than a moment: it becomes a repeated identity, community, and participation system

belonging_route.value: Shared listening, creator attachment, collective interpretation, and fan rituals turn media preference into social belonging and self-description

observations.method: Spotify Culture Next 2026 Gen Z trend interpretation connecting content genres, emotional processing, fandom, creators, and community.
observations.uncertainty: These are platform trend categories rather than clinical or population-level measures of emotion, mental health, fandom intensity, or social connection.
observations.subgroup: Gen Z fans, podcast and music communities, creators, listeners using entertainment to process emotion, and advertisers seeking durable fandom rather than one-off reach.
observations.counterinterpretation: Fandom can offer belonging but can also produce harassment, identity policing, parasocial dependence, and commercial extraction from emotional attachment.

related_sources.claim: Spotify's 2026 Gen Z advertising guide summarizes the report's life-stage, format, and high-attention-moment framing.
Spotify's 2026 investor-day materials provide a related platform strategy signal on interactive, generative, fan-driven media.

boundary: This record adds Spotify's audio-and-fandom platform signal on Gen Z rituals, fitness and gaming identity, cross-format participation, emotional media, and durable fandom. It is a platform-owned cultural synthesis, not respondent-level data, a representative Gen Z study, a clinical finding, or proof that streaming creates the identities or outcomes described.

reproduction_audit.retrieval_hash_scope: Official Spotify Culture Next 2026 materials reviewed for The Fan Edit framing, audience and streaming summary, Power Up, Eye Pods, Dark Side (But Fun), Fandemonium, and life-stage/fandom context.
